meta.title: Purchase Contract for a material line with a contract

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the selectable requisition is on the Open tab.
Select the available material requisition line with a valid contract.

args.goal: Open Purchase Items > Purchase Contract for the selected material line, first verify that submitting without a quantity or contract is refused with the message "Please enter quantity and select a contract for all line items.", then enter a valid quantity, select the valid contract, submit the contract order, and stop on the screen proving that the contract order was created.

steps.note: Execute and observe the Purchase Contract workflow and both required-field validation and successful creation.
Confirm the completed contract-order screen has no application error.
